title: Warning of Interference
subtitle: Vladimir Herzog Institute Warns of Risk in 2026 Elections
excerpt: Risk of US interference in 2026 elections
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The president of the Vladimir Herzog Institute, Rogério Sottili, sent a letter to the president of the Supreme Federal Court (STF), Minister Edson Fachin, warning about the risk of interference from the United States in the 2026 Brazilian elections.

According to the document, there are signs that the outcome of the elections may be influenced by external factors.

Context

Elections are a fundamental process in democracy, and interference from other countries can compromise the integrity of the electoral process.

It is essential that the competent authorities take measures to ensure the security and transparency of the electoral process.

With information from Agência Brasil.
